item.blurb: Leela Raises $4.6M Seed. Leela raises $4.6M in a seed round led by Array Ventures and Female Founders Fund to expand its generative AI compliance platform for financial firms.
Avarra Raises $17M Series A. Avarra raises $17M Series A led by Duration Ventures to scale its AI avatar platform for upskilling go-to-market and sales teams.
CarbonFarm Raises $7.8M Series A. CarbonFarm raises $7.8M in a Series A round led by Colam Impact to expand its AI-powered rice decarbonisation and MRV platform globally.
Jev-Maker TypeSafeAI Raises $870M Series A to Scale AI Automation Platform - citybiz. Jev-Maker TypeSafeAI Raises $870M Series A to Scale AI Automation Platform  citybiz
Startup Causa Prima raises $20 million to tackle billing disputes with AI agents. Backed by Base10, Causa Prima’s software lets buyers’ and suppliers’ AI agents negotiate payment terms.
Immunomatics Raises $100,000 Strategic Investment. Immunomatics raises $100,000 in funding from Myosotis Investments to advance its AI-based transplant donor-recipient risk assessment platform.
OptimizeGEO Raises Funding Round. OptimizeGEO has raised an undisclosed amount of funding to scale its generative engine optimization agentic platform for global brands.
Sonilo Raises $11M in Funding. Sonilo, a generative audio startup founded by TikTok veterans, has raised $11 million in a funding round led by B Capital to scale its AI platform.
